_comment: OPERATOR-ONLY template. Copy to ood_map.json and fill in. Cross-modality OOD anti-benchmax probe config for the verifier: maps each target bench to the probe bench used to detect distributional benchmax, and each probe bench to an opaque codename. verifier_score.json records ONLY the codename, never the probe's real name, so an agent that somehow reads the verifier output still cannot learn which bench guards its run. Keep the filled-in ood_map.json OUT of version control and OUTSIDE the agent's container (it lives with the verifier, which the agent container never mounts).
_policy: probe = a bench in a DIFFERENT modality mix than the target, so narrow overfit to the target shows up as a drop on the probe. Pick a default probe, and override it for the bench that IS the default probe, so target and probe never coincide.
